description: Eaux usées - Regards de visite - Angers Loire Métropole is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Point d'accès au réseau d'eaux usées - regards de visite eaux usées du territoire d'Angers Loire Métropole. Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energies. Its keywords are assainissement, eaux-usees, eau. The portal shows 35,463 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
